chapter: Auditions, musicians and the jazz club
title: Jazz Club job-finding, the Sushans and leftover note items
summary: The Jazz Club found work for favorites; Edmond Sushan donated records; Allen runs through items they already covered.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Let's see. We talked about the Sushant some before and their role. I think one thing that we can't realize is how many jobs the Jazz Club got for people. The society functions. I think there's a lot of work like that going on. And we only heard about it.
I think that's totally true. I certainly know that Edmont gave one of the library branches in town a quite extensive collection of records. I think some very early. Mm-hmm. I was impressed by that.
Yeah. And they found work for their particular favorites. Sure. Yeah. Let's see. We talked about the Southern Yacht Club before.
Okay. Uh. I'll pause for just a second and see where I have that marked.
Well, I don't think there's too much to add on. I have Nick-Knack and Pernell marked here. Something I wanted to ask you about a little more. I don't think we really...
I think we covered as much. Yeah.
As much as you know, huh?
Yeah. Because I really didn't know any more than that. Yeah. And that was largely a subposition.
Yeah. Rob. Just one of those strange kind of characters.
We'll get back to writing. Okay. Cute birthday here. I think we covered that.
They're trying to look out of these things. Okay.
There are things we might drop out of these. Hmm? There are things that we probably might take out of these. Oh, yeah.
